scope.summary: Implement story threading: a single StudioTextStory flows through an ordered chain of frames across pages and spreads; cutting or reordering the thread re-flows the story; in/out ports on each frame expose the thread chain and a threads-view overlay visualizes flow order. Implement linked stories: place-and-link a child copy of a story showing update state, supporting auto-update or warn-on-parent-change, so the same copy can appear in multiple layouts/alternate layouts. Threading state and link state are recorded on the StudioTextStory and surfaced in the linked-resource surface (MT-163). Reflow via LayoutEngine.
acceptance_criteria: ordered thread chain with reflow + ports + overlay; linked stories with auto-update/warn + update state
proof_targets: thread reflow runtime + threads-view overlay; linked-story update-state test
expected_tests: live: story flows through an ordered frame chain across pages; reorder/cut re-flows; threads-view overlay renders
test: linked story child auto-updates or warns on parent change; update-state surfaced

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Threading & linked stories

risk_if_missed: Multi-frame copy cannot flow; long-form text layout impossible; duplicated copy drifts.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
